body:
# Release v1.1.0 - Firmware \& App

**Release Date:** February 15, 2026

This release focuses on enhanced SD card management, improved bruteforce functionality, and new FlipperZero integration features.[^1]

## 🔧 Firmware v1.1.0

### Bug Fixes

- **Bruteforce Module**: Fixed frequency and transmission issues in bruteforce operations[^1]
- **Transmission System**: Corrected pathType 5 (SD root) and 4 (LittleFS) handling to prevent incorrect path generation and fallback behavior[^1]
- **Storage Error Handling**: SD card errors no longer block device boot; seamless fallback to internal flash ensures device remains operational[^1]
- **LittleFS Limitation**: Added error message when LittleFS is used for transmission, as streaming parser requires SD card[^1]


### Improvements

- **SD Card Formatting**: Real-time progressive feedback during format operations with status messages sent to app[^1]
- **Auto Folder Creation**: Automatically creates default folders (`/DATA`, `/DATA/RECORDS`, `/DATA/SIGNALS`, `/DATA/PRESETS`, `/DATA/TEMP`) after format and checks/creates missing folders on boot[^1]
- **Resilient Boot**: Firmware continues in LittleFS-only mode when SD card is not mounted, with user notification through app[^1]
- **SD Status Reporting**: Sends mounted/unmounted state to app for better user feedback[^1]
- **Code Quality**: English comments and refactoring for improved maintainability[^1]


## 📱 App v1.1.0

### New Features

- **FlipperZero Integration**: SubGHz database downloader for extended protocol support[^1]
- **SD Card Management**: Added in-app "Format SD Card" functionality with real-time feedback[^1]


### Improvements \& Fixes

- **Brute Module Selection**: In-app selection between Brute Module 1 or 2[^1]
- **Hardware Button Fix**: Corrected .sub file selection and display for hardware buttons[^1]
- **Device Recognition**: App now recognizes device even after user changes device name[^1]

***

**Installation Notes:** Ensure SD card is properly inserted for full feature access. Device will operate in limited mode using internal flash if SD card is unavailable.[^1]

name: Update 02/2026
body:
# Changelog — EvilCrow-RF-V2

---

## Firmware (C++ / ESP32)

### 2026-02-14

- **[feature]** New BLE message `0xC8` (HwButtonStatus) — sends button1/button2 action + pathType on GetState
- **[feature]** New BLE message `0xC9` (SdStatus) — sends SD card mounted flag, totalMB, freeMB
- **[feature]** New BLE message `0xCA` (NrfStatus) — sends nRF present, initialized, activeState (idle/jamming/scanning/attacking/spectrum)
- **[improvement]** nRF Jammer: dwell=0 turbo mode — sub-millisecond channel hopping via `delayMicroseconds()`
- **[improvement]** nRF Jammer: new `cwOnChannel()` helper replaces all inline CW timing
- **[improvement]** nRF Jammer: dwell=0 flood uses single 3-packet burst (~450 µs) then hops immediately
- **[improvement]** nRF Jammer: max `floodBursts` raised from 10 to 20
- **[improvement]** nRF Jammer: WDT-safe turbo loop with `taskYIELD()` every 64 iterations
- **[fix]** MouseJack scan dwell time increased from 600 µs to 4 ms per channel (was missing most mouse packets)
- **[fix]** MouseJack: added CE LOW→HIGH toggle after channel change (receiver stuck on old channel)
- **[fix]** MouseJack: CRC16 extraction overflow — `<< 9` on `uint16_t` → use `uint32_t` intermediate
- **[fix]** MouseJack: removed redundant `msTransmit(0,0)` key-release for Microsoft STRING/DUCKY
- **[fix]** MouseJack: added missing key-release for Logitech in RAW_HID mode
- **[fix]** MouseJack: added `transmitReliable()` with 5× retransmission for lossy link
- **[fix]** MouseJack: added 2 ms inter-frame delay for Microsoft sequence sync
- **[feature]** DuckyScript: `REPEAT n`, `DEFAULT_DELAY`, `STRINGLN`, multi-modifier combos, `\t` → TAB
- **[feature]** DuckyScript: `MENU`/`APP`, `INSERT`, `HOME`, `END`, `PAGEUP`, `PAGEDOWN`, `PRINTSCREEN`, `SCROLLLOCK`, `PAUSE`/`BREAK`
- **[feature]** 8 new HID key codes + 12 DuckyScript key name mappings in HidPayloads.h
- **[improvement]** MouseJack: extracted tuning constants to named `constexpr` values
- **[improvement]** MouseJack: created `sendKeystroke()` / `typeString()` helpers to reduce duplication

### 2026-02-13

- **[fix]** nRF Jammer: restored CW (Constant Carrier) as default for FHSS/analog targets (BT Classic, Drone, Video, RC, Single Channel)
- **[fix]** nRF Jammer: replaced pulsed CE `writeFast()` (~14% TX duty) with continuous `floodOnChannel()` (~100% duty)
- **[fix]** nRF Jammer: added `writePayload()` in NrfModule — FIFO write without CE toggle
- **[fix]** nRF Jammer: bumped flash config version 2→3 to force reset of incorrect defaults

### 2026-02-12

- **[feature]** Per-mode config structs, 6 new methods, flash persistence in NrfJammer
- **[feature]** `writeFast()` FIFO guard and `releaseSpi()` fix in NrfModule
- **[feature]** 4 new BLE command handlers (`0x42`–`0x45`) for per-mode config get/set/info/reset
- **[feature]** 2 new BLE notification IDs (`0xD6`, `0xD7`) in BinaryMessages.h
- **[feature]** `loadConfigs()` call at boot in main.cpp
- **[fix]** Removed duplicate channel array declarations in NrfJammer.cpp (build-breaking)
- **[fix]** Corrected doc comment path for config file
- **[improvement]** Migrated BatteryModule ADC API from deprecated ESP-IDF 4.x to ESP-IDF 5.x (`adc_oneshot` / `adc_cali`)

---

## Mobile App (Flutter / Dart)

### 2026-02-14

- **[feature]** Device Status: nRF24 card showing chip state (Not Present / Not Init / Jamming / Scanning / Attacking / Spectrum / Idle) with color-coded chip
- **[feature]** Device Status: SD card showing "Not Inserted" or "X MB free / Y MB" with usage progress bar (red when < 10%)
- **[improvement]** SD card icon removed from top status bar, moved to Device Status panel
- **[feature]** HW Button config auto-sync: when device sends 0xC8, SettingsProvider updates button1/button2 action to match firmware state
- **[feature]** `syncButtonsFromDevice()` method in SettingsProvider with persistence
- **[feature]** 3 new binary message parsers (0xC8, 0xC9, 0xCA) in binary_message_parser.dart
- **[feature]** BleProvider: new state variables for SD, nRF, and HW button config from device

### 2026-02-12

- **[feature]** BLE parsers for `0xD6` (per-mode config) and `0xD7` (mode info)
- **[feature]** Command factories for `0x42`–`0x45` (dwell, mode config, mode info, reset)
- **[feature]** Data models: `NrfJamModeConfig`, `NrfJamModeInfo`, `NrfJamModeUiData`
- **[feature]** State management for per-mode config/info caching in BleProvider
- **[feature]** All 12 jammer modes displayed (added Zigbee & Drone entries)
- **[feature]** Per-mode settings dialog (PA, DR, dwell, flooding, bursts)
- **[feature]** Per-mode info dialog (name, description, freq range, channel count)
- **[feature]** Live dwell-time slider during active jamming (cmd `0x42`)
- **[feature]** Reset-to-defaults button with confirmation (cmd `0x45`)
- **[improvement]** `0xD5` parser expanded from 4-byte to 5-byte format with backward compat
